description: This strategy identifies long entry opportunities where price has breached the lower Bollinger Band, indicating an oversold condition within a volatility extreme. Concurrently, the Relative Strength Index (RSI) must also signal an oversold state, and Chaikin Money Flow (CMF) must confirm positive accumulation pressure, suggesting a potential reversal.
entry_logic: Price crosses below BB_lower AND RSI < 30 AND CMF > 0.0
